name: Product Vendor Manager for WooCommerce
author: Tuloss Solutions

sections.description:
Simplify vendor coordination with Product Vendor Manager for WooCommerce — the intuitive plugin that adds a dedicated vendor tab directly to your product edit screens, allowing you to assign multiple vendors per product.

Perfect for stores working with multiple vendors, dropshipping businesses, or wholesale operations, this plugin helps you:

  • ✅ Assign multiple vendors to a single product
  • ✅ Store vendor name, contact person, phone, email, address, comments
  • ✅ Keep all vendor data centralized in WooCommerce
  • ✅ Improve inventory, ordering, and fulfillment workflows

No more spreadsheets or external tools. Everything you need is right where you manage your products.

Key Features

  • Dedicated “Vendor” tab on every product edit page
  • Support for multiple vendors per product
  • Add vendor name, contact person, phone, email, address, comments
  • Clean, user-friendly interface
  • Lightweight and fast — no performance impact
  • Fully compatible with WooCommerce 3.0+

Perfect For

  • Dropshipping stores with backup vendors
  • Multi-source retailers (local + international)
  • Wholesale and B2B shops
  • Inventory and procurement managers
  • Businesses using multiple vendors per product

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.2 or higher
  • WooCommerce 3.0 or higher

Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “Product Vendor Manager for WooCommerce”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the .zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
Can I assign multiple vendors to a single product?

Yes! This plugin fully supports assigning multiple vendors per product. You can add, edit, and manage as many vendors as needed for each product.

Can I add my own custom fields?

Not in v1.0. Currently, the plugin supports predefined vendor fields (name, contact person, phone, email, address, note). Let us know any feature you need: hello tuloss [.] com .

Is this plugin translation-ready?

Yes. The plugin is translation-ready (text domain: product-vendor-manager-for-woocommerce). You can add language files in /languages/.

Does it work with WordPress Multisite?

Yes, it is compatible with Multisite. Activate it on a site-by-site basis or network-wide.

What happens to my data when I uninstall the plugin?

When you uninstall Product Vendor Manager for WooCommerce, all vendor data (including contact person, phone, email, address, and notes) will be permanently deleted from your site. If you want to keep this data, be sure to export or document it before deleting the plugin.
